subject: Music Production
title: George Martin and the Beatles
description: Learn George Martin and the Beatles in one minute.

hook.text: George Martin was a classical music producer at Parlophone when four scruffy lads from Liverpool arrived.

buildup.text: He heard raw talent in their energy and agreed to sign them despite his label's doubts about pop.

discovery.text: Martin used orchestral arrangements and studio tricks to elevate simple rock songs into art.

twist.text: The Beatles called him 'the fifth Beatle' because his production shaped their iconic sound.

climax.text: Martin produced albums that changed music forever, from 'Rubber Soul' to 'Sgt. Pepper.'

punchline.text: A classical producer turned a rock band into legends.

quiz.question: What musical background did George Martin bring to the Beatles?
